adaptations: Standalone personal study/life planner; omit social profiles, advertising and AI upsell

shared: New independently specified mobile personal task planner. White canvas, date/week navigation, category groups and task controls. No brand header, KPI cards, marketing, demo notices, divider bars or desktop adaptation. Host supplies semantic markup/layout/assets; local model styles units, then separately generates behavior. This is assisted transfer, not proof of independent full-product parity. All text>=14px and weight>=500. Native checkbox/select affordances stay native. Shared assembly owns outer spacing and rows. No actual tasks are seeded; filled-state fixtures will be inserted by evaluation through the real create flow.
